result.result:
I wrote the rule and the witnesses, but the gate never got to check them. Both gate runs returned **SCOPE_VIOLATION**, and the cause is a harness fault, not my files, so the code has not even been built yet.

**Why the gate fails:** it reports "changed outside the node's files" for temporary files under `.runtime/tmp/claude-154266/…`. These are output files the shell tool creates every time it runs a command, including the gate command itself. The list also includes files from other coding sessions running at the same time (LVMC_11_18_020, LVMC_11_30_050, LVMC_11_43_010_B_o1) and a cache-state file. Each new gate run creates another such file, so no change to my two files can get past the check. I stopped after two runs and kept the remaining four. To fix it, exclude `.runtime/` from the gate's scope check, or put the runtime's temp directory outside the worktree; then re-run the gate.

**Rule** (`library/TrafficSpec/Rules/LVMC_11/LVMC_11_16_090_A_o1.lean`):
- **Who it covers:** the subject must belong to the motor-vehicle group defined in DEF-NRS-484A-130.
- **When it applies:** the subject's footprint is on a highway region.
- **What it forbids:** any one of three things:
  - acceleration at or above `p.exhibition_accel_min`;
  - speed at or above `p.exhibition_speed_min`;
  - a speed contest: one other motor vehicle stays side by side with the subject, heading the same way, and both accelerate at or above `p.contest_accel_min` at every moment of the last `p.contest_window` seconds.
- For the contest, the same other vehicle has to be there for the whole window, because the blueprint says "one road user throughout". The blueprint set this, so I declared no narrowing of my own.

**Witnesses:** I wrote the five planned scenarios (forbid, permit, idle, blind, branch_1) and added two of my own:
- `branch_2` (violated): the subject cruises at 50 m/s, so the speed limb has a scenario of its own.
- `branch_3` (compliant): two cars side by side, but the other one accelerates too gently to count as a contest.

All scenarios are judged at t = 4–5 s, so the 3-second window is fully recorded. Relations between the cars are computed from their positions and headings rather than supplied.

One of my shell commands was denied: I had attached an extra command to the gate call. It never ran.

The full report is in `task_result.md` in the working directory.
